name: elven-observability/opentelemetry-instrumentation-php
description: Modern fail-open OpenTelemetry instrumentation for PHP applications, with first-class Laravel, FrankenPHP, Symfony and PSR integrations.

suggest.ext-opentelemetry: Enables upstream zero-code auto-instrumentation packages when desired.
suggest.ext-protobuf: Recommended by the upstream OTLP exporter for lower CPU and memory overhead in production.
suggest.ext-curl: Improves HTTP client/exporter performance in many PHP deployments.
suggest.laravel/framework: Enables the Laravel service provider, HTTP middleware, database/cache/queue/event instrumentation and log enrichment.
suggest.symfony/framework-bundle: Enables Symfony bundle-style registration and event subscribers.
suggest.slim/slim: Enables Slim/PSR middleware examples and route naming support.
suggest.yiisoft/yii2: Can be instrumented through the generic HTTP and event helpers.
suggest.open-telemetry/opentelemetry-auto-larave: Optional upstream Laravel auto-instrumentation when ext-opentelemetry is installed.
suggest.open-telemetry/opentelemetry-auto-symfon: Optional upstream Symfony auto-instrumentation when ext-opentelemetry is installed.
suggest.open-telemetry/opentelemetry-auto-slim: Optional upstream Slim auto-instrumentation when ext-opentelemetry is installed.

scripts.lint: find src tests examples -name '*.php' -print0 | xargs -0 -n1 php -l
